before.requirement: For CBOR bytes {0xf9, 0x7c, 0x01}, the existing decode–encode–decode equality assertion must hold.
before.reason: The half precision value decodes to NaN, but the old floating point constructor converts it to JSON null. CBOR encoding and decoding preserve null, and two JSON null values compare equal.

after.requirement: For the same CBOR bytes {0xf9, 0x7c, 0x01}, the existing decode–encode–decode equality assertion must hold.
after.reason: The changed constructor retains NaN as a JSON float. CBOR encoding writes a double precision float, decoding restores NaN, and the existing equality operator compares the two NaNs with ordinary floating point ==, which is false.

claims.reason: The same input and unchanged harness reach the assertion on both sides. Before g0001, NaN becomes null and the assertion passes. After g0001, NaN remains a float and the assertion fails.

location.dependency_reason: The supplied build rule compiles this CBOR fuzz target against the header.
